versions.description_html:
Discover how Log Analytics works in Azure and M365. Learn about tables, KQL queries, data collection rules, costs, and retention strategies simply.

Log Analytics is a filing cabinet for everything your systems whisper to each other. Every sign-in, every file open, and every error becomes a record in that cabinet, and on its own one record is nearly useless.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Log Analytics actually is
  • Where all these logs come from
  • Inside a workspace and its tables
  • Asking questions with a few lines of KQL
  • What teams actually do with it
  • Where the money actually goes
  • How long your data sticks around
  • How it fits into Microsoft 365 and Azure
  • The honest limits, and one question for you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Azure Infrastructure as Code and DevOps with Maik van der Gaag [MVP]
  • Azure Open Datasets - Simply Explained
  • More Azure & Cloud episodes on M365.FM
